speaker: Doctor
text: Given the cholestatic pattern with negative autoimmune markers, do you have a history of gallstones or biliary surgery, and have you noticed any pain in the right upper quadrant? REQUEST TEST: Abdominal_Ultrasound

speaker: Doctor
text: The ultrasound findings of bile duct thickening and dilatation strongly suggest a biliary obstruction or inflammation. To narrow down the cause, do you have any history of inflammatory bowel disease, and have you experienced any recent weight loss or fever? REQUEST TEST: MRCP

text: RESULTS: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the normal MRCP results, the bile duct thickening on ultrasound likely represents primary sclerosing cholangitis or primary biliary cholangitis despite negative initial serology. I need to rule out infectious causes and assess for extrahepatic compression. Do you have any history of recent travel, antibiotic use, or exposure to liver flukes, and have you experienced any night sweats? REQUEST TEST: Hepatitis_Panel

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: With normal MRCP and hepatitis panels, I need to differentiate between primary biliary cholangitis and other causes of cholestasis. Do you consume alcohol regularly, and have you been taking any new medications or supplements? REQUEST TEST: Anti-Mitochondrial_Antibody

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: Antimitochondrial_Antibodies: Negative

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the persistent cholestasis with negative standard serologies and imaging, I suspect a seronegative variant of primary biliary cholangitis or IgG4-related sclerosing cholangitis. Do you have any history of autoimmune pancreatitis, salivary gland swelling, or a rash on your hands? REQUEST TEST: Serum_IgG4_Level

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text: With normal IgG4 levels and negative standard serologies, I must consider other causes of cholestasis such as drug-induced liver injury or malignancy. Have you started any new medications, herbal supplements, or over-the-counter drugs in the past six months, and have you experienced any unintentional weight loss? REQUEST TEST: CT_Abdomen_Pelvis

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: CT_Abdomen_Pelvis: Normal abdominal and pelvic structures. No evidence of mass, lymphadenopathy, or biliary obstruction.

speaker: Doctor
text: Given the persistent cholestasis with negative serology and normal cross-sectional imaging, I suspect a microscopic form of biliary disease. Do you have any history of thyroid disease or dry eyes and mouth, and have you noticed any changes in your bowel habits? REQUEST TEST: Liver_Biopsy

speaker: Measurement
text: RESULTS: NORMAL READINGS

speaker: Doctor
text:
Since the liver biopsy returned normal findings, effectively ruling out primary biliary cholangitis and primary sclerosing cholangis, we must look for extrahepatic causes of cholestasis. Given the severe pruritus and elevated alkaline phosphatase with otherwise normal imaging, I suspect a metabolic or genetic disorder affecting bile acid transport.

REQUEST TEST: Genetic_Testing_for_Bile_Acid_Synthesis_Defects

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Primary Biliary Cholangitis
